title: The unreleased 1967 band film
summary: In January 1967 a producer filmed an hour and fifteen minutes of the band in wide screen and stereo, but it was never released because of union re-use fees.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: Well, unfortunately he hasn't been able to find anything of mine that hasn't already been put out by -- that I had, anyway, in my possession. There was one thing that we did, I'm just terribly sorry that it'll never come out. We made a picture back in January of 1967 in New York. It's an hour and 15 minutes of nothing but the band playing, in wide screen, Eastman color and stereophonic sound, and this fellow made it and he has never been able to do anything with it. But the sound track -- of course he paid for moving picture rights, therefore he cannot put the sound track out as a record without paying everybody again, on account of the union setup.
But there's a few tapes on that that got loose. I've been expecting to see that show up someplace.
Gee, I wonder if that's listed. We'll have to check when we go through the list of films and see if that's listed.
I doubt if that's listed, because it was never released, and very few people know that we even made it.
